t: You're facing St Marylebone Parish Church on the Marylebone Road, built to designs by Thomas Hardwick between 1813 and 1817. It is the third site the parish has used, and the whole area takes its name from the church. Behind it is St Marylebone School, a Church of England school for girls. Buried here are the Austrian composer and pianist Joseph Wölfl, the painter William Payne, who invented the tint known as Payne's grey, and the historian Elizabeth Ogborne. The Duchess of Portland, wife of a Prime Minister, is also buried here.
